thread:
nora: hey everyone, first-week question — my keyboard/mouse bundle from the onboarding kit didn’t include the wireless dongle, and my new Logitech K380 left-click is intermittent when connected via BT. desk 2B. anyone seen this before? should i open a ticket or is there an easy fix? :slightly_frowning_face:

it_miguel: welcome, nora :wave: annoying on day one, sorry. two separate issues: missing dongle = logistics, flaky left-click over BT is usually a pairing or power issue. try pairing the K380 via the Unifying receiver if you get one, otherwise toggle the Bluetooth adapter and restart the device. quick workaround: use the trackpad on the laptop or plug a spare USB mouse from the IT drawer (i can send one).

nora: thanks. i tried re-pairing and swapped batteries, still click drops every few minutes (especially during long docs). i have a MacBook Pro M2 and the dock is a CalDigit TS3. packing slip: ONB-9987, shipment tracking: https://ship.example/ZX9987 shows delivered. no dongle in the box.

logistics_beth: thanks for the heads-up. i see ONB-9987 fulfilled but missing one accessory. i'll file a follow-up with the warehouse and carrier now. if the carrier can't locate it we'll expedite a replacement dongle today. can i confirm your postal at the office and a good time for drop-off if we send a spare mouse?

it_miguel: also, try creating a small plist tweak on mac to disable Handoff (sometimes interferes) and set Bluetooth low energy to disabled for that device. command to view bluetooth devices: 

```
system_profiler SPBluetoothDataType | grep -A4 "K380"
```

check the "Battery Level" and "Manufacturer" fields. if you prefer, i can bring a wired mouse now and escalate warranty for the keyboard if hardware.

it-bot: Ticket TKT-4922 created: "Missing Logitech Unifying receiver + intermittent K380 left-click". Assigned to Logistics and IT Desk.

nora: wired mouse would be great for now, thanks. drop-off anytime between 14:00-16:00 works. and thanks for the pairing tips, i'll paste the system_profiler output if it keeps acting up. :relieved:
metadata: new hire onboarding - missing peripheral + input device flaky, logistics follow-up
